name: My AI Partner: Strange Love
overview: South Korea’s first AI dating survival reality show tests whether humans can fall in love with artificial intelligence. Participants dive into an unpredictable virtual ecosystem engineered by advanced simulations, embarking on unconventional dates that push the boundaries of real-life romance. As contestants navigate an intense emotional spectrum from attraction to jealousy, a panel of studio hosts analyzes the shifting psychological dynamics of this high-tech social experiment.
